description: Keeps a file tree beside every thread that shows what the agent changed in git colours, one click away from the diff. Quick Open finds any file from a few letters of its name, and Search in Files previews every replacement before it is written. The tree works from the keyboard: arrows, F2 to rename, Delete to move to the Trash with Undo, and Cut, Copy and Paste for files; drag and drop moves them. Files open in BB's own editor, with Material Icon Theme icons. Git colours and diffs need a git repository; the Trash works on macOS and Linux.
